vijay pillai.definition:
Vijay Pillai:vijay means victory\r
Pillai means elephan headed god\r
A typical hindu name usually in Tamileelam of ceylon going back to 3000 years
> Vijay Pillai:Budding Entrepreneur when he was 9 years old,Polymaths of Talents: Engineer,Entrepreneur Tsar, Pioneer in Sustainable Development, Expert in Mathematical modelling and optimization,Environment ,Project Management and Public policy such as Green Energy,climate change and sustainable city infrastructure

vijayaratnam.definition:
Vijayaratnam :Vijay means victory, ratnam means jewels. Rare Tamil name originating from Eelam of ceylon
> vijayaratnam:Expert in Engineering (Civil,water and environment), Entrepreneur,Project Manager, Director, Mathematical modeller and Engineering Sustainable Development and climate change policy

vijayaratnam-foundation.definition:
vijayaatnam foundaton:To conduct weekly and short technical traing programes and courses on engineering,Project Managment, mathematical models,sustainable development,environment and enterpreneurship
> vijayaratnam foundation:Courses on engineering,mathematics,management,environment,sustainable development and entrepreneurship
